title: Move 3.3.1.3-dev version display from overview
symptom: The version display on the overview screen clutters the already busy screen. The overview is about AAPS state (dynamic), while version is static and already available on the About screen.
fix: The issue was resolved by commit 86c56831, which moved the version display to a less intrusive location and made it show only when the version is old. The color red is used only when there are uncommitted changes.
evidence_quote: See 86c56831 - Big improvement in my eyes
